data.why: The repo bundles a ready-made DESeq2-style results CSV (Gene, log2FoldChange, padj, baseMean, pvalue, regulation) that matches exactly what the dashboard's column-mapping UI expects.

goals: Upload a differential expression results CSV and map its columns to Gene/log2FoldChange/padj
Adjust log2 fold-change and adjusted p-value thresholds to define significance
Explore the volcano plot (Plotly and Altair) to identify up- and down-regulated genes
Inspect the MA plot to check for expression-dependent bias once baseMean is mapped
Search for specific genes of interest (e.g., TP53, BRCA1) across the filtered results
Export the filtered list of significant genes as CSV or Excel

review.summary: This tree fits the dashboard well: the goal and four phases match the README's upload→map→threshold→explore/search→export flow, and the 10 screens I opened all show what their nodes claim. It needs small fixes before filing: drop the crash probe from the tasks, describe the regulation filter and the Top-N chart the way the code actually works, and add the missing Distributions feature.
